overview.about: The World Wide Technology Championship is a PGA Tour event played at the El Cardonal at Diamante course - a Tiger Woods design - in Los Cabos, Mexico. Held in the autumn, it offers a full-field PGA Tour title in a warm resort setting near the start of the new season. The 2026 tournament is on 5-8 November.
overview.nextEvent: The 2026 World Wide Technology Championship runs 5-8 November at Diamante in Cabo San Lucas, Mexico. As a full PGA Tour event it carries official win status, FedExCup points and a place in the new-season standings.
